# Scope: Tidy

## In

- R1: invite link
- R2: weekly board
- R3: weekly rotation

## Out

- Payments or shared costs, because other apps do this well.

## Later

- R4: swaps, when the pilot shows rotation alone causes friction.

## Constraints

- Web only, mobile-friendly (source: developer's time budget).
